TALE OF THE SOULLESS
Very Early Development
​
SYNOPSIS/STORY
Spoiler
For thousands of years, fiends—Soulless and virtually immortal beings—led by the three Archfiends have dominated their homeworld. Driven by their insatiable craving for Souls, they have developed portals to travel between worlds, seeking to achieve dominion over other beings and harvest their Souls.
However, 400 years ago, as they opened another portal, they encountered an unpredictable resistance: Terrors—Mind-devouring creatures capable of permanently killing them. After centuries of fierce battles and heavy casualties on both sides, a stalemate was finally reached. Desperate to force the Terrors back to their world and close the portal, the fiends redoubled their efforts to explore other dimensions for a means to finally defeat their ultimate enemies.
At the same time, with the Archfiend of Conquest occupied on the frontline and the influence of the new Archfiend of Knowledge curtailed, the power of the Archfiend of Domination is growing unchecked. The fiend's society is becoming increasingly restrictive as a result, and the other fiends are growing restless.
Ciara is a young fiend coming of age, attending an apprenticeship in preparation for her eventual integration into the society, as all are required to do. During her training, she will learn everything necessary for her (almost immortal) life, forge life-changing friendships, and explore various worlds filled with both wonders and perils.

FEATURES
Spoiler
Charge-Turn Battles: Agility affects when the player (or the enemy) takes a turn and how many actions (
functional
).
Seven schools of magic, each with unique characteristics: Inflict multiple debuffs with chaos magic and dispel it for massive damage. Sacrifice HP to create a shield that protects an ally with nether magic (
18 spells currently functional, need balancing
).
Mastery system: Skills and spells grow more powerful the more they are used. Some spells can only be learned after achieving mastery over certain other spell(s) (
functional
).
Gathering and alchemy: Gather ingredients in the wild and create potions or bombs to aid in combat or exploration (
in progress
,
partially functional
).
Patrons and favours: At a certain point in their life, a fiend can choose a patron to gain patron-specific powers. Defeating enemies in certain ways or making certain decisions will earn favours from the patron, which can be used to unlock more powerful powers (
in progress
).
Day and night cycle: Certain actions will advance the time of day. Some NPCs and enemies are only found during the day or night (
functional
).
Meaningful character interaction: Ciara's actions will affect other characters and their opinions of her, as well as unlock choices throughout her journey (
in progress, partially functional
).
DESIGN PHILOSOPHY/INSPIRATION
Spoiler
Story: In a typical JRPG story, we play as the hero and defeat the demon lord. But what if we play from the demons' perspective instead? The fiends are generally bloodthirsty and quick to resort to violence and need to harvest Souls to satisfy their thirst. As they invade other worlds, there will be local heroes trying to save their own world, but people with strong virtues make their Souls especially desirable for the fiends.
Combat: Out of all the FF (5, 6, 7 (the old one, not remake), 10, 12) and DQ (8, 9) games I've played, I like the combat in FF X the most, so I draw inspiration from X for the combat system.
Spell: I generally don't like the linear progression of spells (fire, fira (stronger fire), and firaga (stronger fira)). So I try to give each spell unique effects, e.g. fire bolt: deal damage and chance to burn, scorching bolt: deal double damage if target is burning, ignite: deal damage and remove all burn stacks, deal damage to all enemies proportional to the number of stacks.
I've been working on the game for around six months in my free time. Up until now, I've focused on the art and sprite, and now beginning to develop the combat system and more mapping.
The demo is planned for the end of this year/early next year, could be early if things go well.

posts.author: ChessF01
posts.body:
It's been a while since I posted an update here. Life gets in the way.
What's done:
- Opening cutscene + tutorial.
- 1st day class + free time.
- Tutorial dungeon + boss fight.
- Made new MC sprite + the 2 party members with (IMO) better resolutions and animations (overworld + battle anim). Might still need to tweak some stuff with the animation later, especially the battle anim. Plus, I want to learn how to use Yanfly Action Sequence Pack for battle anim. I commissioned an artist (Dynaheart) for the sprites, can't do the pixel art myself.
- Made expressions for the pictures of the playable characters.
- Made framework for MC's personalities.
Spoiler:
Images
Opening
Tutorial battle. Battleback is still a placeholder. I want to make the battleback myself. It sounds fun and gives me the push to learn to draw backgrounds finally, but it's not a priority.
Enemy sprites are still placeholders. Ideally, I'll make the enemy sprites myself. It's doable, but not a priority right now.
Spoiler:
Technical stuff: personalities
To set the MC's personality, certain choices will increase or decrease variables that influence the personality (currently: Reckless vs. Cautious, Ruthless vs. Merciful, Selfish vs. Benevolent). In the future, I can factor in these variables when making different dialogues and choices. It shouldn’t be too difficult, as it is mostly just conditional statements, but it might be a lot of work. The player won't be able to see which personalities they currently have, but I plan to make an NPC that gives a hint to the player's current personalities.
Also, why does RPG Maker not have AND OR operator???
Credits:
- Character sprites by Dynaheart.
- Enemy sprites from Aekashics Librarium.
To do next:
- Make 1st story quest after tutorial dungeon.
- Make more free time options (hanging out with other NPCs, studying spells, exploring dungeons, etc).
- Make more spells.
- Enemy balancing.
- Make a system to allow the player to take different classes to learn spells, gain spell xp, get alchemy recipes, etc.
- Now that I've found a sprite artist, I can start planning to replace npc placeholders. Not a priority right now.

Trying to post an update here at least once a month.
What's done:
- 2 new maps for classrooms. 1 map for utility stuffs.
- Several new spells. Learn new spells and recipes by fulfilling the prerequisites and taking classes.
- First map for the city: Temple Square. Will be used for the next story quest.

First City Map
I want to make each trait more interesting, not just adding stats. The traits shown here are not final and most of them haven't been implemented yet. I'll also add more of them as the development progresses.
